To: Reception staff
From: Olivia Grant, Building Services Manager
Date: October 3
Subject: New visitor check-in system

Starting Monday, October 10, all visitors to Kingsway Tower will check in using the new tablets at the main reception desk. Visitors will type their name and the name of the person they are meeting, and the system will print a badge {1}. This should shorten waiting times during busy mornings.

{2} Please help any visitors who have trouble using the tablets, especially older guests. You should also check that each badge shows the correct date before handing it over.

A technician from Clearpoint Systems, the company that developed the software, will {3} a short training session for all reception staff on Friday at 3:00 P.M. in Meeting Room B. {4}, please read the attached user guide and write down any questions you have.

Thank you,
Olivia

texts.body:
Brightwater Family Clinic - Notice to Patients

Beginning November 1, patients will be able to book, change, or cancel appointments through our new online system at any time of day. Until now, appointments could only be made by telephone during office hours. Patients who prefer to call may continue to do so. The phone line will remain open Monday to Friday, 8:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M.

To use the online system, you will need your patient number, which is printed in the top right corner of every receipt from our clinic. If you cannot find it, please ask a receptionist at your next visit.

Please also note that our on-site pharmacy will change its hours from November 1. It will close at 5:30 P.M. on weekdays instead of 7:00 P.M., and it will no longer open on Saturdays. Prescriptions can still be collected at our partner pharmacy on Harbor Street, which is open seven days a week.

texts.label: Job advertisement
texts.body:
Maravela Resort, Phuket - Now Hiring
Front Office Agent (full-time)

Maravela Resort, a 220-room beachfront hotel, is looking for a friendly and organized Front Office Agent to join our team. Responsibilities include checking guests in and out, handling room reservations, and answering guest questions in person and by phone.

Requirements:
- At least one year of experience in a hotel or other customer service role
- Good spoken and written English; a third language is an advantage
- Willingness to work rotating shifts, including weekends

We offer free staff meals, uniforms, and paid English and Chinese language classes. To apply, e-mail a résumé and a short cover letter to Daniela Ruiz, Human Resources Manager, by October 20. Interviews will be held during the last week of October.

From: Mina Chaiyasit
To: Daniela Ruiz
Date: October 14
Subject: Front Office Agent position

Dear Ms. Ruiz,

I am writing to apply for the Front Office Agent position advertised on your resort's website. For the past eighteen months, I have worked as a receptionist at a busy dental clinic in Krabi, where I schedule appointments, greet patients, and handle payments. Before that, I completed a diploma in tourism.

I speak Thai and English, and I am currently taking evening classes in Chinese. I understand that the position requires working on weekends, and I am happy to do so.

My résumé and cover letter are attached. I will be visiting my family in Phuket from October 26 to October 31, so it would be convenient for me to attend an interview in person during that time.

Sincerely,
Mina Chaiyasit
